# Terry Wang

> Personal homepage of Terry Wang — a curious, truth-seeking Linux enthusiast since Fedora Core 1. Believes in KISS, technology, and Financial Literacy for good causes. Self-hosted on a Raspberry Pi 4 running Fedora aarch64.

Contact: `echo "cm9vdEB0ZXJyeS5pbQo=" | base64 -d`

## About

Terry Wang has been running Linux as a daily driver since Fedora Core 1 (2003). The homepage at [terry.im](https://terry.im) is a single static `index.html` styled as a terminal session — no tracking, no analytics, no JavaScript frameworks, just a sprinkle of vanilla JS for the theme switcher. The site is self-hosted on a Raspberry Pi 4 running Fedora aarch64, online since December 2020.

Recurring themes across the writing and profile: KISS as an engineering value, the Unix philosophy, long-term financial literacy, and skepticism toward hype cycles. The homepage's "principles" section captures the investing stance in five lines — long time horizons, conviction sizing, and the view that the market exposes human weakness faster than it rewards intelligence.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://terry.im): Terminal-themed landing page with links, principles, and system status
- [Blog](https://log.terry.im): Long-form writing on Linux, self-hosting, technology, and financial literacy
